notablePrerequisites: Your library size is greater than or equal to each opponent's life total.
description:
Cast Body of Reaserch by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to your library size.
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing the Fractal to deal damage equal to its power to each other creature and to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
